title.en: Query-image TV blindness floor, multi-query separation, and three-regime error contrast

statement.en: Over Mathlib ℝ (standard axioms only), ObservationalFidelity proves the exact query TV blindness floor, empty-source infeasibility, coarsening and macro-refinement monotonicity, zero-TV coexistence with FiberViabilitySplit, three-way query separation, and three-regime error contrast.

laws.en: Finite pushforward obeys total-variation data processing (tvDist_pushforward_le); for any chi : U -> V, query q : V -> O, and mu : FinDist V, every local distribution nu obeys massOutside (q o chi) (pushforward q mu) <= tvDist (pushforward (q o chi) nu) (pushforward q mu), with equality constructively attained when Nonempty U while IsEmpty U renders FinDist U empty (optimal_query_tv_floor, empty_source_infeasible).

Post-composing observations with a coarsening map or factoring maps through a finer macro partition weakly lowers massOutside (coarsening_tv_mono, macro_refinement_tv_mono), while zero observable query TV on dirac distributions coexists with total FiberViabilitySplit and macro-kernel refutation on Becoming.OplaxHistory.C2CoupledAlignmentWitness.

On diagonal Bool x Bool supports, individual per-query zero TV does not imply simultaneous marginal feasibility (per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal, sum gap >= 3/5), and simultaneous zero-TV marginals over uniform Bool x Bool fail joint TV realizability (joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist, tvDist >= 1/2).

Open-loop Markov kernels accumulate per-step TV error linearly (sequential_kernel_tv_bound) and subadditively across independent tensor sites (independent_tensor_tv_bound), unified in three_regime_error_contrast with contractive feedback tubes (Becoming.AlignmentReals.metricSlack, Becoming.Reals.iterVar_eq_metricSlack) and coupled C2/concurrent reserve breakdown (C2CoupledAlignmentWitness, ConcurrentSerialWitness).

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) through the Mathlib periphery workspace (#13); requires finite Fintype state/query spaces, Nonempty U for optimal TV attainment, time-homogeneous Markov steps, and contractive alpha in [0, 1) for regime-2 feedback tubes.

does_not_show.en: Finite probability distribution TV bounds and discrete counterexamples never verify that empirical neural policy rollouts or real sensor pipelines are time-homogeneous, independent across sites, or contractive (Rule 2).
Does not prove finite-sample empirical convergence rates, continuous measurable-space Radon-Nikodym bounds, or continuous-time SDEs.

detail.en: empty_source_infeasible (IsEmpty U), zero_tv_does_not_prevent_fiber_viability_split (zero TV on C2CoupledAlignmentWitness with total Viability.Kernel failure), per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal (3/5 gap), joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist (1/2 gap), and three_regime_error_contrast part 3 (3-step ConcurrentSerialWitness depletion vs. serialized recovery).
